description: This file defines a React component for a customizable Button, along with several specialized button variants such as GradientButton, FloatingActionButton, and IconButton. It utilizes framer-motion for animations and handles visual effects including ripples, hover states, and loading spinners.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: Main Button component supporting variants, sizes, ripple effects, loading state, and icon positioning.

methods.name: GradientButton
methods.description: A styled button with gradient background and border for special emphasis.

methods.name: FloatingActionButton
methods.description: A circular, floating button positioned at the bottom right, typically for primary actions.

methods.name: IconButton
methods.description: A small, icon-only button with size variants.
